prompt: A file was read from the shop's export storage account yesterday. Is the reader in the activity log?

choices.text: Yes, with their IP address
choices.why: Reading a blob is a data-plane operation; it is not there.

choices.text: No; reads are in the account's own logs
choices.why: Right. The activity log covers Resource Manager operations.

choices.text: Yes, but only if the read failed
choices.why: Failure or success, data-plane reads are elsewhere.

choices.text: Only for the first 24 hours
choices.why: Time has nothing to do with it; the kind of operation does.

prompt: Why does the pipeline appear in `Caller` as a GUID?

choices.text: Its name was hidden for privacy
choices.why: Nothing is hidden; principals are identified by id.

choices.text: It signed in with a client secret
choices.why: Any service principal appears by id, however it signed in.

choices.text: A service principal is recorded by its id
choices.why: Right. People appear by their user principal name.

choices.text: The record was corrupted
choices.why: It is the normal form for a service principal.

prompt: A dynamic value such as `Properties.sku` is given a type with the function ___ before it is displayed as text.

choices.text: The pipeline, on Friday
choices.why: The caller is a person, not the pipeline's id.

choices.text: ana, on Saturday 17 October
bruno, on Thursday afternoon
choices.why: Bruno changed the database; he deleted nothing.

choices.text: Nobody; it expired
choices.why: Storage accounts do not expire; the log shows a DELETE.

prompt: The by-caller summary shows two people with changes. Why does the lesson call them worth a look?

choices.text: People are not allowed to change production
choices.why: They are; the concern is review, not permission.

choices.text: Their changes all failed
choices.why: Most succeeded; one of bruno's failed.

choices.text: They made more changes than the pipeline
choices.why: The pipeline made the most.

choices.text: No pull request reviewed a portal change
choices.why: Right. That is the gap Thursday's incident went through.

prompt: How many changes did the pipeline's identity make in the week?
hint: The changes column for the GUID.

prompt: Put Thursday's access and database changes in the order the activity log recorded them.
items: ana grants bruno SQL DB Contributor
bruno scales the database to S1
carla scales it back to S3
trap: Putting the grant before the refusal is the slip: the refusal is what prompted it.

prompt: For how many days does Azure keep the activity log without a diagnostic setting?

choices.text: It belongs to the subscription
choices.why: Right. Its diagnostic setting is set there, not on a resource.

choices.text: Diagnostic settings can only be subscription-scoped
choices.why: Lesson 8's was scoped to an app.

choices.text: It makes the setting free
choices.why: Scope does not change ingestion cost.

choices.text: So that the workspace is created too
choices.why: The workspace is a parameter; it already exists.

prompt: Why is an alert on every role assignment not noise, when an alert on every deployment would be?
hint: How often does each happen in a healthy subscription?

choices.text: Role assignments are billed and deployments are not
choices.why: Neither is billed.

choices.text: They are rare, and change who holds what access
choices.why: Right. A second person sees each one the same day.

choices.text: Deployments are already reviewed by the WAF
choices.why: The WAF inspects HTTP requests, not deployments.

choices.text: Activity log alerts cannot watch deployments
choices.why: They can; the shop chooses not to.

prompt: Which questions can the activity log answer? Choose all that apply.

choices.text: Who resized the database on Thursday
choices.why: Yes. A write through Resource Manager.

choices.text: Who granted a role on rg-shop
choices.why: Yes. A role assignment write.

choices.text: Who read the payments API key from the vault
choices.why: No. That is a data-plane read, in the vault's own logs.

choices.text: Which customer's checkout failed at 14:10
choices.why: No. That is in AppRequests.
